Class SocketClient

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.network.client.socket.SocketClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerHandler, VirtualClient, VirtualServer
public class SocketClient extends Object implements ServerHandler, VirtualClient
SocketClient is the client-side handler for socket communication. Exposes methods to interact with the server via sockets.
